--[[
	UIBuilder Module - Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Orchestrates all UI construction. Delegates to UIBuilderConstants, UIWidgets, UIToolPanels.
]]

-- task.wait between requires spreads obfuscated VM bootstrap across frames so the
-- initial UIBuilder load doesn't pile onto the same frame as Part's mixin chain.
local C = require(script.Constants); task.wait()
local W = require(script.Widgets); task.wait()
local TP = require(script.ToolPanels); task.wait()
local BP = require(script.BuildProperties); task.wait()
local IP = require(script.InventoryPanel); task.wait()

local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local UIBuilder = {}
-- Module-scoped (not self-state): persists across SnapshotTheme/RestoreTheme cycles so the descendant-walk
-- inside UpdateTheme can short-circuit when the same font is re-applied. Walking ~1000+ descendants per
-- color-picker drag was a measurable cost; this skip relies on font being a string-name comparison.
local _currentFontName = T.Font.Name

-- BUILD HUD
local function buildHUD(screenGui)
	local hud = Instance.new("Frame"); hud.Name = "HUD"; hud.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hud.Position = UDim2.new(0,LAYOUT.HudX,0,LAYOUT.HudY); hud.Size = UDim2.new(0,LAYOUT.HudWidth,0,0)
	hud.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; hud.Parent = screenGui; W.addListLayout(hud, 4)
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "Panel"; panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); panel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; panel.Active = true; panel.LayoutOrder = 0; panel.Visible = false; panel.Parent = hud
	W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel,6,6,6,6); W.addListLayout(panel,4); table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
	local refs = {}

	local nameBar = W.makeBlob("NameBar", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,26)); nameBar.LayoutOrder = 0; W.addPadding(nameBar,6,4,0,0)
	local dragH = Instance.new("TextButton"); dragH.Name = "DragHandle"; dragH.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	dragH.Text = ""; dragH.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); dragH.ZIndex = 2; dragH.Parent = nameBar
	refs.StatusDot = Instance.new("Frame"); refs.StatusDot.Name = "StatusDot"; refs.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = T.Green
	refs.StatusDot.Size = UDim2.new(0,6,0,6); refs.StatusDot.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0.5,-3)
	refs.StatusDot.BorderSizePixel = 0; refs.StatusDot.Parent = nameBar; W.addCorner(refs.StatusDot, UDim.new(0,3))
	refs.NameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel"); refs.NameLabel.Name = "NameLabel"; refs.NameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	refs.NameLabel.Text = "No Selection"; refs.NameLabel.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; refs.NameLabel.Font = T.Font; refs.NameLabel.TextSize = 11
	refs.NameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; refs.NameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	refs.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,-44,1,0); refs.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,0); refs.NameLabel.Parent = nameBar
	refs.HUDClose = Instance.new("TextButton"); refs.HUDClose.Name = "Close"; refs.HUDClose.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	refs.HUDClose.Text = "X"; refs.HUDClose.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; refs.HUDClose.Font = T.Font; refs.HUDClose.TextSize = 10
	refs.HUDClose.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,1,0); refs.HUDClose.Position = UDim2.new(1,-2,0,0); refs.HUDClose.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0)
	refs.HUDClose.ZIndex = 3; refs.HUDClose.Parent = nameBar
	local iconH = Instance.new("Frame"); iconH.Name = "Icons"; iconH.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	iconH.Size = UDim2.new(0,32,0,16); iconH.Position = UDim2.new(1,-46,0.5,-8); iconH.Parent = nameBar; W.addListLayout(iconH, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	refs.EnabledIcon = W.makeBlob("EnabledIcon", iconH, UDim2.new(0,14,0,14))
	local el = Instance.new("TextLabel"); el.BackgroundTransparency = 1; el.Text = "E"; el.TextColor3 = T.Gold; el.Font = T.Font; el.TextSize = 9; el.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); el.Parent = refs.EnabledIcon

	local function makeHudRow(name, labelText, lsz, defVal, lo)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = name; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,28); row.LayoutOrder = lo; row.Parent = panel
		local lb = W.makeBlob(name.."Label", row, UDim2.new(0,44,1,0))
		local lt = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lt.BackgroundTransparency = 1; lt.Text = labelText
		lt.TextColor3 = T.Gold; lt.Font = T.Font; lt.TextSize = lsz; lt.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); lt.Parent = lb
		local iw = W.makeBlob(name.."InputWrap", row, UDim2.new(1,-48,1,0)); iw.Position = UDim2.new(0,48,0,0)
		local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = name.."Box"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tb.Text = defVal
		tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 13; tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false; tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0)
		tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = iw; return tb
	end
	refs.EmitBox = makeHudRow("Emit","Emit",12,"1",1); refs.EmitRow = refs.EmitBox.Parent.Parent
	refs.DelayBox = makeHudRow("Delay","Delay",12,"0",2)

-- THEME MANAGEMENT
local function _sweepDead(arr)
	local j = 1; for i = 1, #arr do if arr[i].Parent then arr[j] = arr[i]; j = j + 1 end end
	for i = j, #arr do arr[i] = nil end
end
function UIBuilder:UpdateTheme(primary, secondary, tertiary, panelAlpha, blobAlpha, fontName, textAccent, blobColor, scrollBarColor, fontScale, bgImage, bgImageTransparency)
	local _themed = W.getThemed()
	-- Sweep destroyed refs from themed arrays to prevent unbounded growth
	_sweepDead(_themed.strokes); _sweepDead(_themed.panels); _sweepDead(_themed.blobs)
	_sweepDead(_themed.fills); _sweepDead(_themed.scrollbars); _sweepDead(_themed.toggles)
	if _themed.panelImages then _sweepDead(_themed.panelImages) end
	-- Sweep evenDots: dots are created per populate cycle for selected items with
	-- EvenDistribution support; without sweep the array grows unboundedly across
	-- selection changes and theme refresh walks dead instances.
	if _themed.evenDots then _sweepDead(_themed.evenDots) end
	if primary then T.Border = primary; for _, s in ipairs(_themed.strokes) do if s.Parent then s.Color = primary end end end
	if secondary then T.PanelBg = secondary; for _, p in ipairs(_themed.panels) do if p.Parent then p.BackgroundColor3 = secondary end end end
	if tertiary then T.SliderFill = tertiary; for _, f in ipairs(_themed.fills) do if f.Parent then f.BackgroundColor3 = tertiary end end end
	if blobColor then T.BlobBg = blobColor; for _, b in ipairs(_themed.blobs) do if b.Parent then b.BackgroundColor3 = blobColor end end end
	if scrollBarColor then T.ScrollBar = scrollBarColor; for _, sb in ipairs(_themed.scrollbars) do if sb.Parent then sb.ScrollBarImageColor3 = scrollBarColor end end end
	if panelAlpha ~= nil then T.PanelAlpha = panelAlpha; for _, p in ipairs(_themed.panels) do if p.Parent and not p:GetAttribute("_opaquePanel") then p.BackgroundTransparency = panelAlpha end end end
	if blobAlpha ~= nil then T.BlobAlpha = blobAlpha; for _, b in ipairs(_themed.blobs) do if b.Parent then b.BackgroundTransparency = blobAlpha end end end
	if fontName and fontName ~= _currentFontName then
		local ok, font = pcall(function() return Enum.Font[fontName] end)
		if ok and font then
			T.Font = font; _currentFontName = fontName
			if self._screenGui then
				for _, desc in ipairs(self._screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
					if (desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("TextBox")) and not desc:GetAttribute("_noFontOverride") then
						desc.Font = font
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if fontScale and fontScale > 0 then
		T.FontScale = fontScale
		if self._screenGui then
			for _, desc in ipairs(self._screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
				if (desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("TextBox")) and not desc:GetAttribute("_noFontOverride") then
					if not desc:GetAttribute("_baseTextSize") then desc:SetAttribute("_baseTextSize", desc.TextSize) end
					desc.TextSize = math.max(6, math.round(desc:GetAttribute("_baseTextSize") * fontScale))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if textAccent then
		-- Capture old shades BEFORE updating T (critical for second+ changes to work)
		local oldShades = {
			Color3.new(T.BrightGold.R, T.BrightGold.G, T.BrightGold.B),
			Color3.new(T.Gold.R, T.Gold.G, T.Gold.B),
			Color3.new(T.MutedGold.R, T.MutedGold.G, T.MutedGold.B),
			Color3.new(T.DarkGold.R, T.DarkGold.G, T.DarkGold.B),
		}
		local bright, gold, muted, dark
		if C.isDefaultTextAccent(textAccent) then
			bright = C.DEFAULT_TEXT_SHADES.BrightGold
			gold = C.DEFAULT_TEXT_SHADES.Gold
			muted = C.DEFAULT_TEXT_SHADES.MutedGold
			dark = C.DEFAULT_TEXT_SHADES.DarkGold
		else
			bright, gold, muted, dark = C.deriveTextShades(textAccent)
		end
		T.TextAccent = textAccent; T.BrightGold = bright; T.Gold = gold; T.MutedGold = muted; T.DarkGold = dark
		local newShades = {bright, gold, muted, dark}
		-- Tolerance 0.04 (~10/255) to handle floating point drift from HSV derivation
		local TOL = 0.04
		if self._screenGui then
			for _, desc in ipairs(self._screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("TextBox") then
					local tc = desc.TextColor3
					for i, old in ipairs(oldShades) do
						if math.abs(tc.R - old.R) < TOL and math.abs(tc.G - old.G) < TOL and math.abs(tc.B - old.B) < TOL then
							desc.TextColor3 = newShades[i]; break
						end
					end
					if desc:IsA("TextBox") then local pc = desc.PlaceholderColor3
						for i, old in ipairs(oldShades) do if math.abs(pc.R-old.R)<TOL and math.abs(pc.G-old.G)<TOL and math.abs(pc.B-old.B)<TOL then desc.PlaceholderColor3=newShades[i]; break end end
					end
				end
				if (desc:IsA("ImageButton") or desc:IsA("ImageLabel")) then local ic = desc.ImageColor3
					for i, old in ipairs(oldShades) do if math.abs(ic.R-old.R)<TOL and math.abs(ic.G-old.G)<TOL and math.abs(ic.B-old.B)<TOL then desc.ImageColor3=newShades[i]; break end end end
				-- Frames with a gold-accent BackgroundColor3 (e.g. the resize-edge highlight). Skip
				-- frames marked `_noColorRemap`  -  the ColorPicker's HS canvas layers use pure-white
				-- BG for gradient compositing, and a textAccent that derives a near-white BrightGold
				-- would otherwise hijack those whites and tint the rainbow on the next theme change.
				if (desc:IsA("Frame") or desc:IsA("ScrollingFrame")) and not desc:GetAttribute("_noColorRemap") then local bc = desc.BackgroundColor3
					for i, old in ipairs(oldShades) do if math.abs(bc.R-old.R)<TOL and math.abs(bc.G-old.G)<TOL and math.abs(bc.B-old.B)<TOL then desc.BackgroundColor3=newShades[i]; break end end end
			end
		end
		for _, tog in ipairs(_themed.toggles) do if tog.Parent then local dot = tog:FindFirstChild("Dot")
			if tog:GetAttribute("IsOn") then tog.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,55,30); if dot then dot.BackgroundColor3 = T.Green end
			else tog.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; tog.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; if dot then dot.BackgroundColor3 = dark end end
		end end
	end
	-- Producer: `WidgetAxis.trackAxis` registers `{btn, color, selBg}` entries.
	-- `_selected` on the button (set by WidgetAxis axis-toggle handlers) drives the
	-- selected-style paint here.
	for _, e in ipairs(_themed.axisButtons) do if e.btn.Parent then -- axis buttons
		if e.btn:GetAttribute("_selected") then e.btn.BackgroundColor3 = e.selBg; e.btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15; e.btn.TextColor3 = e.color
		else e.btn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; e.btn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; e.btn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold end
	end end
	-- axisColored entries follow AxisX/Y/Z theme colors. Used by WidgetAxis checkmarks etc.
	if _themed.axisColored then
		for _, e in ipairs(_themed.axisColored) do
			if e.inst and e.inst.Parent then
				local col = T["Axis" .. (e.axis or "X")]
				if col then e.inst[e.prop] = col end
			end
		end
	end
	-- EvenDistribution per-axis dots paint BrightGold (on) / DarkGold (off) based on
	-- the `_even` attribute; without this sweep theme edits leave the dots stuck on
	-- initial-time colors until the next populate-driven refresh.
	if _themed.evenDots then
		for _, dot in ipairs(_themed.evenDots) do
			if dot and dot.Parent then
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = dot:GetAttribute("_even") and T.BrightGold or T.DarkGold
			end
		end
	end
	-- Decorative background image: write Image + ImageTransparency to every registered
	-- panel-image layer. Empty BgImage paints nothing, ImageTransparency=1 hides cleanly.
	if bgImage ~= nil then T.BgImage = bgImage end
	if bgImageTransparency ~= nil then T.BgImageTransparency = bgImageTransparency end
	if _themed.panelImages then
		for _, img in ipairs(_themed.panelImages) do
			if img.Parent then
				img.Image = T.BgImage or ""
				img.ImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency or 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function UIBuilder:SnapshotTheme()
	return {
		Border = T.Border, PanelBg = T.PanelBg, SliderFill = T.SliderFill,
		BlobBg = T.BlobBg, PanelAlpha = T.PanelAlpha, BlobAlpha = T.BlobAlpha, Font = T.Font,
		TextAccent = T.TextAccent, ScrollBar = T.ScrollBar,
		BrightGold = T.BrightGold, Gold = T.Gold, MutedGold = T.MutedGold, DarkGold = T.DarkGold,
		BgImage = T.BgImage, BgImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency,
	}
end

function UIBuilder:RestoreTheme(snap)
	-- Don't pre-set text shades: UpdateTheme needs current (preview) values as oldShades to shade-match
	self:UpdateTheme(snap.Border, snap.PanelBg, snap.SliderFill, snap.PanelAlpha, snap.BlobAlpha, snap.Font.Name, snap.TextAccent, snap.BlobBg, snap.ScrollBar)
end

function UIBuilder:Build(TypeRegistry)
	-- Reset widget tracking
	W.reset()
	for _, old in pairs(game:GetService('CoreGui'):GetChildren()) do

	end
	local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui"); sg.Name = "PartIclesUI"; sg.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	sg.ResetOnSpawn = false; sg.Enabled = false; sg.Parent = game:GetService('CoreGui')
	UIBuilder._screenGui = sg
	-- Hand the ScreenGui to the toast system so showToast can parent its frames.
	if W.setToastParent then W.setToastParent(sg) end
	local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale"); uiScale.Scale = 1.15; uiScale.Parent = sg

	local hudRefs = buildHUD(sg)
	local propRefs = BP.buildProperties(sg)
	local settingsRefs = buildSettings(sg)
	local counter, counterLabel = buildCounter(sg)
	local optIndicator, optLabel = buildOptIndicator(sg)
	local toggleRefs = buildToggles(sg)
	local qMenuRefs = TP.buildQMenu(sg)
	local resizeRefs = TP.buildResize(sg)
	local retimeRefs = TP.buildRetime(sg)
	local clipboardRefs = TP.buildClipboard(sg, TypeRegistry)
	local shifterRefs = TP.buildShifter(sg, TypeRegistry)
	local hueRefs = TP.buildHueChanger(sg)
	local emitCodeRefs = TP.buildEmitCode(sg)
	local fixRefs = TP.buildFixBanner(sg)
	local themeRefs = BP.buildThemeEditor(sg)
	local dotsMenuRefs = W.buildDotsMenu(sg)
	local inventoryRefs = IP.build(sg)
	-- Randomizer modal panel. Wiring + button handlers attached in init.server.lua
	-- because RandomizerWiring needs ctx-bound deps. Refs merge into `ui` below
	-- (panel + buttons + headerCloseBtn referenced by name from init.server.lua).
	local RandomizerPanel = require(script.RandomizerPanel)
	local randomizerRefs = RandomizerPanel.build(sg)
	-- Re-key under "Randomizer" prefix to avoid clashing with QMenu's "Randomize" Activated button.
	local randomizerUI = {
		RandomizerPanel = randomizerRefs.panel,
		RandomizerSectionList = randomizerRefs.sectionList,
		RandomizerRollAllBtn = randomizerRefs.rollAllBtn,
		RandomizerApplyBtn = randomizerRefs.applyBtn,
		RandomizerCancelBtn = randomizerRefs.cancelBtn,
		RandomizerHeaderCloseBtn = randomizerRefs.headerCloseBtn,
	}
	-- ShortcutPanel modal. Bootstrap (Modules/Shortcuts) wires the Settings panel
	-- "Shortcuts" button to wiring.open/close, and panel headerCloseBtn to close().
	local ShortcutPanel = require(script.ShortcutPanel)
	local shortcutRefs = ShortcutPanel.build(sg)
	local shortcutUI = {
		ShortcutPanel = shortcutRefs.panel,
		ShortcutsList = shortcutRefs.scrollList,
		ShortcutsSearch = shortcutRefs.searchBox,
		ShortcutsReset = shortcutRefs.resetBtn,
		ShortcutsHeaderClose = shortcutRefs.headerCloseBtn,
		ShortcutsLeaderLabel = shortcutRefs.leaderLabel,
		ShortcutsLeaderSet = shortcutRefs.leaderSetBtn,
		ShortcutsLeaderClear = shortcutRefs.leaderClearBtn,
	}

	-- Default positions: [Resize][Retime][Shifter][Clipboard][Properties] left to right
	local dockGap = 6
	local col1 = -(LAYOUT.PropsX + dockGap + 110)                -- Clipboard (110w, closest to Properties)
	local col2 = -(LAYOUT.PropsX + dockGap + 110 + dockGap + 110) -- Shifter (110w)
	local col3 = -(LAYOUT.PropsX + dockGap + 110 + dockGap + 110 + dockGap + 120) -- Retime (120w)
	local col4 = -(LAYOUT.PropsX + dockGap + 110 + dockGap + 110 + dockGap + 120 + dockGap + 120) -- Resize (120w)
	local defaultPositions = {
		[clipboardRefs.ClipboardPanel]  = UDim2.new(1, col1, 0, LAYOUT.PropsY),
		[shifterRefs.ShifterPanel]      = UDim2.new(1, col2, 0, LAYOUT.PropsY),
		[retimeRefs.RetimePanel]        = UDim2.new(1, col3, 0, LAYOUT.PropsY),
		[resizeRefs.ResizePanel]        = UDim2.new(1, col4, 0, LAYOUT.PropsY),
		[hueRefs.HuePanel]             = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -400),
		[emitCodeRefs.EmitCodePanel]    = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, -260),
		-- RandomizerPanel: centered modal (220x400, _noSnap so resolveOverlap won't
		-- rescue it). W.makeToolPanel sets no default Position, so a missing entry
		-- here would leave the modal pinned at top-left (0,0) on first open.
		[randomizerRefs.panel]          = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.5, -200),
		-- ShortcutPanel: centered modal (300x420, _noSnap). Same default-Position
		-- requirement as RandomizerPanel above  -  never ship a _noSnap panel without
		-- an explicit defaultPositions entry or it pins to top-left.
		[shortcutRefs.panel]            = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -210),
	}

	-- Record original sizes for reset
	local defaultSizes = {}
	for panel, pos in pairs(defaultPositions) do
		panel.Position = pos; defaultSizes[panel] = panel.Size
	end
	defaultSizes[inventoryRefs.InventoryPanel] = inventoryRefs.InventoryPanel.Size

	-- Register panels for magnetic snap
	W.registerPanel(hudRefs.HUD)
	W.registerPanel(propRefs.PropsPanel)
	W.registerPanel(settingsRefs.SettingsPanel)
	W.registerPanel(qMenuRefs.QMenu)
	W.registerPanel(resizeRefs.ResizePanel)
	W.registerPanel(retimeRefs.RetimePanel)
	W.registerPanel(hueRefs.HuePanel)
	W.registerPanel(clipboardRefs.ClipboardPanel)
	W.registerPanel(shifterRefs.ShifterPanel)
	W.registerPanel(inventoryRefs.InventoryPanel)
	if inventoryRefs.InvDetail then W.registerPanel(inventoryRefs.InvDetail) end

	-- Paired spawning (place to the left of partner)
	local function positionPairBeside(panel, partner)
		if partner.Visible then
			local scale = 1
			local sg2 = partner:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
			if sg2 then local us = sg2:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if us then scale = us.Scale end end
			local pW = panel.AbsoluteSize.X / scale
			local px = partner.AbsolutePosition.X / scale - pW - 6
			panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, partner.Position.Y.Scale, partner.Position.Y.Offset)
		end
	end

	local function toggleWithPair(panel, partner)
		panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
		if panel.Visible then
			positionPairBeside(panel, partner)
			task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(panel) end)
		end
	end

	-- Layout reset
	local function resetLayout()
		for panel, pos in pairs(defaultPositions) do panel.Position = pos end
		for panel, size in pairs(defaultSizes) do panel.Size = size end
		hudRefs.HUD.Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.HudX, 0, LAYOUT.HudY)
		propRefs.PropsPanel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.PropsX, 0, LAYOUT.PropsY)
		qMenuRefs.QMenu.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -40)
		inventoryRefs.InventoryPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -240, 0.2, 0)
		if inventoryRefs.InvDetail then inventoryRefs.InvDetail.Visible = false end
		if inventoryRefs.InvImportDialog then inventoryRefs.InvImportDialog.Visible = false end
		if inventoryRefs.InvAddDialog then inventoryRefs.InvAddDialog.Visible = false end
	end

	-- Wire toggles (HUD/Props close buttons wired in QOLWiring where ctx is available)
	local function dimToggle(btn, panel)
		btn.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = not panel.Visible; btn.TextColor3 = panel.Visible and T.Gold or T.DarkGold end)
	end
	-- Settings toolbar toggle: wired to toolToggles.toggleSettings below so click + Action
	-- share one path (color stays in sync regardless of trigger).
	settingsRefs.SettingsClose.Activated:Connect(function() settingsRefs.SettingsPanel.Visible = false; toggleRefs.settingsToggle.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold end)
	dimToggle(toggleRefs.counterToggle, counter)
	dimToggle(toggleRefs.qolToggle, qMenuRefs.QMenu)
	if qMenuRefs.QMenuClose then qMenuRefs.QMenuClose.Activated:Connect(function() toggleRefs.qolToggle.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold end) end

	-- Tool-toggle helpers extracted so both QMenu Activated and Actions shortcut
	-- handlers go through the same path (pair positioning + deferred resolveOverlap +
	-- Settings color sync). Exposed via the returned `ui` table.
	local function _toggleSolo(panel)
		panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
		if panel.Visible then task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(panel) end) end
	end
	local toolToggles = {
		toggleResize    = function() toggleWithPair(resizeRefs.ResizePanel, retimeRefs.RetimePanel) end,
		toggleRetime    = function() toggleWithPair(retimeRefs.RetimePanel, resizeRefs.ResizePanel) end,
		toggleClipboard = function() toggleWithPair(clipboardRefs.ClipboardPanel, shifterRefs.ShifterPanel) end,
		toggleShifter   = function() toggleWithPair(shifterRefs.ShifterPanel, clipboardRefs.ClipboardPanel) end,
		toggleHue       = function() _toggleSolo(hueRefs.HuePanel) end,
		toggleEmitCode  = function() _toggleSolo(emitCodeRefs.EmitCodePanel) end,
		toggleSettings  = function()
			settingsRefs.SettingsPanel.Visible = not settingsRefs.SettingsPanel.Visible
			toggleRefs.settingsToggle.TextColor3 = settingsRefs.SettingsPanel.Visible and T.Gold or T.DarkGold
		end,
	}
	qMenuRefs.Resize.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleResize)
	qMenuRefs.Retime.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleRetime)
	qMenuRefs.Hue.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleHue)
	qMenuRefs.Clipboard.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleClipboard)
	qMenuRefs.Shifter.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleShifter)
	qMenuRefs.EmitCode.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleEmitCode)
	toggleRefs.settingsToggle.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleSettings)
	settingsRefs.ResetLayout = resetLayout

	if settingsRefs.EditThemeButton then
		settingsRefs.EditThemeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			themeRefs.ThemeEditor.Visible = true
		end)
	end

	local ui = {}
	for _, tbl in ipairs({hudRefs, propRefs, settingsRefs, qMenuRefs, resizeRefs, retimeRefs, hueRefs, clipboardRefs, shifterRefs, emitCodeRefs, fixRefs, themeRefs, dotsMenuRefs, inventoryRefs, randomizerUI, shortcutUI}) do
		for k, v in pairs(tbl) do ui[k] = v end
	end
	sg.Enabled = true -- Show UI only after everything is built (prevents partial flash under obfuscation)
	ui.ScreenGui = sg; ui.UIScale = uiScale; ui.Counter = counter; ui.CounterLabel = counterLabel
	ui.OptIndicator = optIndicator; ui.OptLabel = optLabel; ui.Toggles = toggleRefs
	-- Tool-toggle helpers exposed so shortcut Actions can mirror toolbar behavior.
	for k, v in pairs(toolToggles) do ui[k] = v end
	return ui
end

UIBuilder.Theme = T
UIBuilder.color3ToHex = C.color3ToHex
UIBuilder.hexToColor3 = C.hexToColor3
UIBuilder.FONT_OPTIONS = C.FONT_OPTIONS
UIBuilder.THEME_PRESETS = C.THEME_PRESETS
UIBuilder.hideDropdownExpansion = W.hideDropdownExpansion
UIBuilder.getThemed = W.getThemed
UIBuilder.cleanup = W.reset -- disconnect UIS connections on teardown
return UIBuilder

-- BuildProperties - Part-Icles V5 (split from UIBuilder/init.luau)
-- Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local WidgetEvents = require(script.Parent.WidgetEvents)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT
local BuildProperties = {}

-- Append the Events section to a per-type section body. Each transformed type gets its
-- own collapsible Events block at the bottom of its section list. Returns the events
-- refs sub-table to slot under refs.<Type>.Events.
local function appendEventsTo(typeRefs, section, typeName, layoutOrder)
	if not section then return end
	local body = section:FindFirstChild("Body") or section
	typeRefs.Events = WidgetEvents.buildEventsSection(body, typeName, layoutOrder)
end

function BuildProperties.buildProperties(screenGui)
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "PropertiesPanel"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(1,-LAYOUT.PropsX,0,LAYOUT.PropsY)
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,LAYOUT.PropsWidth,0,LAYOUT.PropsHeight)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true; panel.Visible = false; panel.Parent = screenGui
	W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel,6,6,6,6)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
	W.makeResizable(panel, 200, 100)
	local refs = {}

	-- Header
	local header = W.makeBlob("Header", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,26)); header.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
	local ht = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ht.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ht.Text = "Properties"
	ht.TextColor3 = T.Gold; ht.Font = T.Font; ht.TextSize = 12; ht.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	ht.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,1,0); ht.Position = UDim2.new(0,8,0,0); ht.Parent = header
	local cb = Instance.new("TextButton"); cb.Name = "Close"; cb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cb.Text = "X"; cb.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; cb.Font = T.Font; cb.TextSize = 12
	cb.Size = UDim2.new(0,20,1,0); cb.Position = UDim2.new(1,-22,0,0); cb.ZIndex = 3; cb.Parent = header; refs.CloseButton = cb
	local pdh = Instance.new("TextButton"); pdh.Name = "DragHandle"; pdh.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pdh.Text = ""; pdh.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,1,0); pdh.ZIndex = 2; pdh.Parent = header; W.makeDraggable(panel, pdh)
	-- Search bar
	local searchWrap = W.makeBlob("SearchWrap", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,20)); searchWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,28)
	local sb = Instance.new("TextBox"); sb.Name = "SearchBox"; sb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sb.Text = ""; sb.PlaceholderText = "Search properties..."; sb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; sb.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	sb.Font = T.Font; sb.TextSize = 9; sb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; sb.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	sb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); sb.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); sb.BorderSizePixel = 0; sb.Parent = searchWrap; refs.SearchBox = sb
	-- Scroll
	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); scroll.Name = "Content"; scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,52); scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,-52); scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3; scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, scroll)
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0; scroll.Parent = panel; W.addListLayout(scroll, 4)
	W.addCollapseButton(header, {searchWrap, scroll}, {
		panel = panel, expandedSize = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.PropsWidth, 0, LAYOUT.PropsHeight),
		collapsedSize = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.PropsWidth, 0, 38), arrowPos = UDim2.new(1,-36,0,0),
	})

	-- ==========================================
	-- PART PROPERTIES
	-- ==========================================
	local partDefs = {
		{name = "Spawning", rows = {
			{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"},
			{key="Orientation", label="Orientation", type="dropdown", options={"None","FacingCamera","FacingCameraWorldUp","VelocityParallel","VelocityPerpendicular"}, default="None"},
			{key="AnimateLoop", label="Loop", type="toggle"},
			{key="Direction", label="Direction", type="dropdown", options={"Top","Bottom","Front","Back","Left","Right"}, default="Top"},
			{key="Enabled", label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="Rate", label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime", label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="SpreadAngle", label="SpreadAngle", type="input", default="0, 0", placeholder="x, y"},
			{key="RotOrder", label="Rot Order", type="dropdown", options={"Global","LocalXYZ","LocalXZY","LocalYXZ","LocalYZX","LocalZXY","LocalZYX"}, default="Global"},
			{key="Rot", label="Rotation", type="axis_input", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, placeholder="min, max", config={kind="axis-link", axes={"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, evenAttrs={X="RotXEven", Y="RotYEven", Z="RotZEven"}}},
			{key="PosMode", label="Pos. Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Local","Global","RigidLocal"}, default="Local"},
			{key="Pos", label="Position", type="axis_input", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, placeholder="min, max", config={kind="axis-link", axes={"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, evenAttrs={X="PosXEven", Y="PosYEven", Z="PosZEven"}}},
			{key="ZOffset", label="Z-Offset", type="input", default="0"},
		}},
		{name = "Appearance", rows = {
			{key="Material", label="Material", type="dropdown", options={"Plastic","SmoothPlastic","Neon","Glass","Metal","DiamondPlate","Foil","Brick","Concrete","Granite","Marble","Slate","Wood","WoodPlanks","Fabric","Ice","Sand","Grass","Pebble","Rock"}, default="Plastic"},
			{key="Brightness", label="Brightness", type="graph"},
			{key="Color", label="Color", type="color"},
			{key="Transparency", label="Transparency", type="graph"},
			{key="Size", label="Size", type="axis_graph_select", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, config={kind="axis-link", axes={"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"}}},
		}},
		{name = "Movement", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Speed", label="Speed", type="graph"},
			{key="PosOffset", label="Displacement", type="axis_graph_select", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, config={kind="axis-link", axes={"PosOffsetX","PosOffsetY","PosOffsetZ"}}},
			{key="RotMode", label="Rotation Mode", type="dropdown", options={"OverLife","Speed"}, default="OverLife"},
			{key="RotSpeed", label="Rotation Speed", type="axis_graph_select", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, config={kind="axis-link", axes={"RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ"}}},
			{key="Acceleration", label="Acceleration", type="input", default="0, 0, 0", placeholder="x, y, z"},
			{key="Drag", label="Drag", type="input", default="0"},
			{key="DirMode", label="Dir. Mode", type="dropdown", options={"RigidLocal","Local","Global"}, default="RigidLocal"},
			{key="DisplacementMode", label="Displacement Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Global","Local","RigidLocal"}, default="Global"},
			{key="InvertMotion", label="Reverse Motion", type="toggle"},
			{key="AccelerationTowardsInstance", label="Accel toward", type="toggle_group", children={
				{key="AccelTarget", label="Target", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="AccelTarget"}},
				{key="AccelStrength", label="Strength", type="graph"},
			}},
		}},
		{name = "Shape", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="UseShape", label="Use shape", type="toggle_group", children={
				{key="Shape",            label="Shape",            type="dropdown", options={"Box","Sphere","Cylinder","Disc"}, default="Box"},
				{key="ShapeInOut",       label="Direction",        type="dropdown", options={"Outward","Inward","InAndOut"}, default="Outward"},
				{key="ShapePartial",     label="Hollow",           type="input",    default="0", placeholder="0=solid, 1=hollow"},
				{key="LookAtInitially",  label="Look at initially", type="toggle"},
				{key="ShapePart",        label="Shape Part",        type="path",    config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="ShapePart", validate="BasePart"}},
			}},
		}},
		{name = "Flipbook", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="FlipMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"None","OneShot","Loop"}, default="OneShot"},
			{key="FlipFramerate", label="Framerate", type="input", default="30, 30", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="FlipStartRandom", label="StartRandom", type="toggle"},
			{key="FlipReverse", label="Reverse", type="toggle"},
		}},
		{name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Timescale", label="Timescale", type="graph"},
			{key="Keyframes", label="Anim. Steps", type="input", default="100"},
			{key="Linger", label="Linger", type="input", default="0", placeholder="seconds"},
			{key="EmitParent", label="Emit Into", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="EmitParent", acceptAnyInstance=true}},
			{key="Link", label="Link Dir.", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="Link", setAttributes={LinkSource="Object"}, clearAttributes={LinkSource="None"}}},
			{key="LinkSource", label="Link", type="dropdown", options={"None","Camera","Object"}, default="None"},
			{key="LinkMode", label="Link Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Weld","Follow","Pivot","WeldWithoutRotation","RigidLocal"}, default="Follow"},
			{key="PreloadTexture", label="Preload Texture", type="toggle"},
			{key="Pool", label="Pool", type="toggle"},
		}},
	}

	refs.MeshSection, refs.Part = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "Meshes", partDefs, 0)
	refs.MeshSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.Part, refs.MeshSection, "Part", 100)
	-- ==========================================
	-- BEAM PROPERTIES
	-- ==========================================
	local beamDefs = {
		{name = "Spawning", rows = {
			{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"},
			{key="AnimateLoop", label="Loop", type="toggle"},
			{key="Enabled", label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="Rate", label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime", label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="Attachment0", label="Attachment 0", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", renderTemplateProperty="Attachment0", validate="Attachment"}},
			{key="Attachment1", label="Attachment 1", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", renderTemplateProperty="Attachment1", validate="Attachment"}},
		}},
		{name = "Appearance", rows = {
			{key="Texture", label="Texture", type="input", default="", placeholder="rbxassetid:// or ID"},
			{key="Brightness", label="Brightness", type="graph"},
			{key="Width0", label="Width0", type="graph"},
			{key="Width1", label="Width1", type="graph"},
			{key="LightEmission", label="Light Emission", type="graph"},
			{key="LightInfluence", label="Light Influence", type="graph"},
		}},
		{name = "Geometry", rows = {
			{key="CurveSize0", label="CurveSize0", type="graph"},
			{key="CurveSize1", label="CurveSize1", type="graph"},
			{key="Segments", label="Segments", type="graph"},
			{key="TextureLength", label="Tex. Length", type="graph"},
			{key="TextureSpeed", label="Tex. Speed", type="graph"},
			{key="TextureMode", label="Tex. Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Stretch","Wrap","Static"}, default="Stretch"},
			{key="ZOffset", label="ZOffset", type="input", default="0"},
			{key="FaceCamera", label="FaceCamera", type="toggle"},
		}},
		{name = "Flipbook", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="FlipMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"None","OneShot","Loop"}, default="OneShot"},
			{key="FlipFramerate", label="Framerate", type="input", default="30, 30", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="FlipStartRandom", label="StartRandom", type="toggle"},
			{key="FlipReverse", label="Reverse", type="toggle"},
		}},
		{name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Timescale", label="Timescale", type="graph"},
			{key="Keyframes", label="Anim. Steps", type="input", default="100"},
			{key="EmitParent", label="Emit Into", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="EmitParent", acceptAnyInstance=true}},
			{key="PreloadTexture", label="Preload Texture", type="toggle"},
			{key="Pool", label="Pool", type="toggle"},
		}},
	}

	refs.BeamSection, refs.Beam = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "Beams", beamDefs, 1)
	refs.BeamSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.Beam, refs.BeamSection, "Beam", 100)

	do local beamBody = refs.BeamSection:FindFirstChild("Body"); if beamBody then refs.BlenderSection, refs.BlenderAddBtn, refs.BlenderStateList = W.makeBlenderBox(beamBody, "AddState", "StateList") end end

	-- ==========================================
	-- POINTLIGHT PROPERTIES
	-- ==========================================
	local plDefs = {
		{name = "Spawning", rows = {
			{key="Enabled", label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="Rate", label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime", label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},
		}},
		{name = "Appearance", rows = {
			{key="Range", label="Range", type="graph"},
			{key="Brightness", label="Brightness", type="graph"},
			{key="Color", label="Color", type="color"},
			{key="Shadows", label="Shadows", type="toggle"},
		}},
		{name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Timescale", label="Timescale", type="graph"},
			{key="Keyframes", label="Anim. Steps", type="input", default="100"},
			{key="Linger", label="Linger", type="input", default="0"},
			{key="EmitParent", label="Emit Into", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="EmitParent", acceptAnyInstance=true}},
			{key="Pool", label="Pool", type="toggle"},
		}},
	}

	refs.PointLightSection, refs.PointLight = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "PointLights", plDefs, 2)
	refs.PointLightSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.PointLight, refs.PointLightSection, "PointLight", 100)

	-- ==========================================
	-- HIGHLIGHT PROPERTIES
	-- ==========================================
	local hlDefs = {
		{name = "Spawning", rows = {
			{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"}, {key="AnimateLoop", label="Loop", type="toggle"},
			{key="Enabled", label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="Rate", label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime", label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},

function BuildProperties.buildThemeEditor(screenGui)
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "ThemeEditor"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-110,0.5,-180); panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,220,0,0)
	panel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; panel.Visible = false; panel.ZIndex = 5; panel.Parent = screenGui
	W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel,6,6,6,6); W.addListLayout(panel,4)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)

	local refs = {}

	local header = W.makeBlob("Header", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,24)); header.LayoutOrder = 0
	local ht = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ht.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ht.Text = "Theme Editor"
	ht.TextColor3 = T.Gold; ht.Font = T.Font; ht.TextSize = 12; ht.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	ht.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0); ht.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,0); ht.Parent = header
	local dh = Instance.new("TextButton"); dh.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dh.Text = ""
	dh.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0); dh.ZIndex = 2; dh.Parent = header; W.makeDraggable(panel, dh)

	local function makeThemeColorRow(label, lo, defaultColor)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = label:gsub("%s+","").."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24); row.LayoutOrder = lo; row.Parent = panel
		local rl = W.makeBlob("L", row, UDim2.new(0,70,1,0)); W.makeLabel("L", rl, label, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 9)
		local swatchBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); swatchBtn.Name = "Swatch"; swatchBtn.BackgroundColor3 = defaultColor; swatchBtn.Text = ""
		swatchBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,20,0,20); swatchBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,74,0,2); swatchBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0; swatchBtn.AutoButtonColor = false; swatchBtn.Parent = row
		W.addCorner(swatchBtn, UDim.new(0,4)); W.addStroke(swatchBtn)
		local hw = W.makeBlob("HW", row, UDim2.new(1,-100,1,0)); hw.Position = UDim2.new(0,100,0,0)
		local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = "Hex"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tb.Text = C.color3ToHex(defaultColor)
		tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 10; tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false; tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = hw
		return {hex = tb, swatch = swatchBtn}
	end
	refs.AccentColor = makeThemeColorRow("Accent", 1, T.Border); refs.BgColor = makeThemeColorRow("Background", 2, T.PanelBg)
	refs.BlobColor = makeThemeColorRow("Blob", 3, T.BlobBg); refs.SliderColor = makeThemeColorRow("Slider", 4, T.SliderFill)
	refs.ScrollBarColor = makeThemeColorRow("Scroll Bar", 5, T.ScrollBar); refs.TextColor = makeThemeColorRow("Text Accent", 6, T.TextAccent)

	-- Opacity convention: slider 0 = fully opaque, slider 100 = fully transparent. Maps
	-- 1:1 to Roblox's BackgroundTransparency / ImageTransparency (0..1) without inversion.
	local function makeOpacityRow(label, lo, defaultAlpha)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.BackgroundTransparency = 1; row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24); row.LayoutOrder = lo; row.Parent = panel
		local rl = W.makeBlob("L", row, UDim2.new(0,100,1,0)); W.makeLabel("L", rl, label, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
		local rw = W.makeBlob("W", row, UDim2.new(1,-104,1,0)); rw.Position = UDim2.new(0,104,0,0)
		local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tb.Text = tostring(math.floor(defaultAlpha * 100 + 0.5))
		tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 10; tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false; tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = rw
		return tb
	end
	refs.PanelOpacityBox = makeOpacityRow("Panel Opacity %", 7, T.PanelAlpha)
	refs.BlobOpacityBox = makeOpacityRow("Blob Opacity %", 8, T.BlobAlpha)

	-- Background Image row: text input accepting raw asset ID, full rbxassetid:// URL, or empty.
	-- Storage normalizes to T.BgImage; ThemeWiring drives the parse + UpdateTheme call.
	local bgImgRow = Instance.new("Frame"); bgImgRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; bgImgRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24); bgImgRow.LayoutOrder = 8.3; bgImgRow.Parent = panel
	local bgImgL = W.makeBlob("L", bgImgRow, UDim2.new(0,100,1,0)); W.makeLabel("L", bgImgL, "Background Image", T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
	local bgImgW = W.makeBlob("W", bgImgRow, UDim2.new(1,-104,1,0)); bgImgW.Position = UDim2.new(0,104,0,0)
	local bgImgBox = Instance.new("TextBox"); bgImgBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1; bgImgBox.Text = T.BgImage or ""
	bgImgBox.PlaceholderText = "rbxassetid://..."; bgImgBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	bgImgBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; bgImgBox.Font = T.Font; bgImgBox.TextSize = 9; bgImgBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	bgImgBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false; bgImgBox.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); bgImgBox.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); bgImgBox.BorderSizePixel = 0; bgImgBox.Parent = bgImgW
	bgImgBox.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	refs.BgImageBox = bgImgBox

	-- Background Image Opacity %: same inversion as Panel Opacity (slider 0% = transparent).
	refs.BgImageOpacityBox = makeOpacityRow("Bg Image Opacity %", 8.6, T.BgImageTransparency)

	local ftRow = Instance.new("Frame"); ftRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ftRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24); ftRow.LayoutOrder = 9; ftRow.Parent = panel
	local ftL = W.makeBlob("L", ftRow, UDim2.new(0,50,1,0)); W.makeLabel("L", ftL, "Font", T.MutedGold, T.Font, 9)
	local fontLbl, fontWrap, fontOnChanged = W.makeDropdown("Font", ftRow, C.FONT_OPTIONS, T.Font.Name)
	fontWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1,-54,1,0); fontWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0,54,0,0)
	refs.FontDropdown = fontLbl; refs.FontDropdownOnChanged = fontOnChanged

	local _fsOnChanged = nil
	local fsSl, fsVal, fsSv, fsGv = W.makeSlider(panel, 1, 200, 100, function(v) if _fsOnChanged then _fsOnChanged(v) end end, "%d%%")
	fsSl.LayoutOrder = 9.5
	refs.FontSizeSetVal = fsSv; refs.FontSizeGetVal = fsGv
	refs.setFontSizeOnChanged = function(fn) _fsOnChanged = fn end

	local presetNames = {"Custom"}; for _, p in ipairs(C.THEME_PRESETS) do table.insert(presetNames, p.name) end
	local presetRow = Instance.new("Frame"); presetRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; presetRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); presetRow.LayoutOrder = 10; presetRow.Parent = panel
	local pLbl = W.makeLabel("PresetLbl", presetRow, "Preset"); pLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,LAYOUT.LabelWidth,1,0)
	local presetLbl, presetWrap, presetOnChanged = W.makeDropdown("PresetDropdown", presetRow, presetNames, "Custom")
	presetWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1,-LAYOUT.LabelWidth-4,1,0); presetWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0,LAYOUT.LabelWidth+2,0,0)
	refs.PresetOnChanged = presetOnChanged; refs.PresetDropdownLbl = presetLbl

	local codeTitle = W.makeBlob("CodeTitle", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,18)); codeTitle.LayoutOrder = 11
	W.makeLabel("L", codeTitle, "Theme Code", T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
	local codeW = W.makeBlob("CodeW", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,36)); codeW.LayoutOrder = 12
	local tcb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tcb.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tcb.Text = ""; tcb.PlaceholderText = "Paste or copy theme code"
	tcb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tcb.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; tcb.Font = T.Font; tcb.TextSize = 8; tcb.TextWrapped = true
	tcb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; tcb.ClearTextOnFocus = false; tcb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,-4)
	tcb.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,2); tcb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tcb.Parent = codeW; refs.ThemeCodeBox = tcb

	local codeBtnRow = Instance.new("Frame"); codeBtnRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; codeBtnRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20); codeBtnRow.LayoutOrder = 13; codeBtnRow.Parent = panel
	W.addListLayout(codeBtnRow, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	refs.ExportTheme = W.makeButton("Export", codeBtnRow, "Export", UDim2.new(0.5,-1,1,0), T.MutedGold); refs.ExportTheme.TextSize = 9; refs.ExportTheme.LayoutOrder = 0
	refs.ImportTheme = W.makeButton("Import", codeBtnRow, "Import", UDim2.new(0.5,-1,1,0), T.MutedGold); refs.ImportTheme.TextSize = 9; refs.ImportTheme.LayoutOrder = 1

	local actionRow = Instance.new("Frame"); actionRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; actionRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24); actionRow.LayoutOrder = 14; actionRow.Parent = panel
	W.addListLayout(actionRow, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	refs.ApplyTheme = W.makeButton("Apply", actionRow, "Apply", UDim2.new(0.33,-2,1,0), T.Green); refs.ApplyTheme.TextSize = 10; refs.ApplyTheme.LayoutOrder = 0
	refs.CancelTheme = W.makeButton("Cancel", actionRow, "Cancel", UDim2.new(0.33,-2,1,0), T.DarkGold); refs.CancelTheme.TextSize = 10; refs.CancelTheme.LayoutOrder = 1
	refs.ResetTheme = W.makeButton("Reset", actionRow, "Reset", UDim2.new(0.33,-2,1,0), T.Red); refs.ResetTheme.TextSize = 10; refs.ResetTheme.LayoutOrder = 2

	refs.ThemeEditor = panel; return refs
end

-- BuildPropertiesScreen  -  property-panel sections for screen-space types (Blur/Bloom/CC/Atmosphere/ImageLabel).
-- Split from BuildProperties.luau to keep both files under the 500-line cap as ImageLabel's definition grew.
-- Consumers: BuildProperties.buildProperties() calls buildSections(scroll, refs) at the end of its own build.

local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local WidgetEvents = require(script.Parent.WidgetEvents)
local BuildPropertiesScreen = {}

local function appendEventsTo(typeRefs, section, typeName)
	if not section then return end
	local body = section:FindFirstChild("Body") or section
	typeRefs.Events = WidgetEvents.buildEventsSection(body, typeName, 100)
end

local function screenSpawning()
	return {name = "Spawning", rows = {
		{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"},
		{key="AnimateLoop",  label="Loop", type="toggle"},
		{key="Enabled",      label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
		{key="Rate",         label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
		{key="Lifetime",     label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},
	}}
end

local function screenAdvanced()
	return {name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {
		{key="Timescale",  label="Timescale",   type="graph"},
		{key="Keyframes",  label="Anim. Steps", type="input", default="100"},
		{key="Linger",     label="Linger",      type="input", default="0"},
		{key="EmitParent", label="Emit Into",   type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="EmitParent", acceptAnyInstance=true}},
	}}
end

-- ImageLabel adds PreloadTexture to its Advanced  -  other screen types don't have texture assets.
local function imageLabelAdvanced()
	return {name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {
		{key="Timescale",      label="Timescale",       type="graph"},
		{key="Keyframes",      label="Anim. Steps",     type="input", default="100"},
		{key="Linger",         label="Linger",          type="input", default="0"},
		{key="EmitParent",     label="Emit Into",       type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="EmitParent", acceptAnyInstance=true}},
		{key="PreloadTexture", label="Preload Texture", type="toggle"},
	}}
end

function BuildPropertiesScreen.buildSections(scroll, refs)
	-- BLUR
	local blurDefs = { screenSpawning(),
		{name = "Appearance", rows = { {key="Size", label="Size", type="graph"} }},
		screenAdvanced(),
	}
	refs.BlurSection, refs.Blur = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "Blurs", blurDefs, 7)
	refs.BlurSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.Blur, refs.BlurSection, "Blur")

	-- BLOOM
	local bloomDefs = { screenSpawning(),
		{name = "Appearance", rows = {
			{key="Intensity", label="Intensity", type="graph"},
			{key="Size",      label="Size",      type="graph"},
			{key="Threshold", label="Threshold", type="graph"},
		}},
		screenAdvanced(),
	}
	refs.BloomSection, refs.Bloom = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "Blooms", bloomDefs, 8)
	refs.BloomSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.Bloom, refs.BloomSection, "Bloom")

	-- COLOR CORRECTION
	local ccDefs = { screenSpawning(),
		{name = "Appearance", rows = {
			{key="Brightness", label="Brightness", type="graph"},
			{key="Contrast",   label="Contrast",   type="graph"},
			{key="Saturation", label="Saturation", type="graph"},
			{key="TintColor",  label="TintColor",  type="color"},
		}},
		screenAdvanced(),
	}
	refs.ColorCorrectionSection, refs.ColorCorrection = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "ColorCorrections", ccDefs, 9)
	refs.ColorCorrectionSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.ColorCorrection, refs.ColorCorrectionSection, "ColorCorrection")

	-- ATMOSPHERE
	local atmDefs = { screenSpawning(),
		{name = "Appearance", rows = {
			{key="Density", label="Density", type="graph"},
			{key="Offset",  label="Offset",  type="graph"},
			{key="Glare",   label="Glare",   type="graph"},
			{key="Haze",    label="Haze",    type="graph"},
			{key="Color",   label="Color",   type="color"},
			{key="Decay",   label="Decay",   type="color"},
		}},
		screenAdvanced(),
	}
	refs.AtmosphereSection, refs.Atmosphere = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "Atmospheres", atmDefs, 10)
	refs.AtmosphereSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.Atmosphere, refs.AtmosphereSection, "Atmosphere")

	-- IMAGE LABEL
	-- Position / Size parsed via CSV inputs: "ScaleX, OffsetX, ScaleY, OffsetY" -> UDim2.
	-- AnchorPoint / Acceleration parsed via CSV: "x, y" -> Vector2.
	-- Grid parsed as "cols, rows" -> two separate config attrs (GridCols, GridRows) so tooling treats them independently.
	-- Per-frame pixel size is computed at emit time as sheet dimensions / grid (see ImageSheetSize.luau).
	local imageLabelDefs = {
		{name = "Spawning", rows = {
			{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"},
			{key="AnimateLoop",  label="Loop", type="toggle"},
			{key="Enabled",      label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="Rate",         label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime",     label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="RotRange",     label="Rotation", type="input", default="0, 0", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="RotSpeed",     label="Rot Speed", type="graph"},
			{key="RotMode",      label="Rot Mode",  type="dropdown", options={"OverLife","Speed"}, default="OverLife"},
		}},
		{name = "Appearance", rows = {
			{key="Image",                  label="Image",          type="input", placeholder="rbxassetid://"},
			{key="ImageColor3",            label="ImageColor",     type="color"},
			{key="ImageTransparency",      label="Transparency",   type="graph"},
			{key="BackgroundColor3",       label="BG Color",       type="color"},
			{key="BackgroundTransparency", label="BG Transparency",type="graph"},
			{key="ScaleType",              label="ScaleType",      type="dropdown", options={"Stretch","Slice","Tile","Fit","Crop"}, default="Stretch"},
			{key="ResampleMode",           label="ResampleMode",   type="dropdown", options={"Default","Pixelated"}, default="Default"},
		}},
		{name = "Layout", rows = {
			{key="Position",    label="Position",    type="input", default="0.5, 0, 0.5, 0", placeholder="sx, ox, sy, oy"},
			{key="ImgSize",     label="Size",        type="input", default="0, 100, 0, 100", placeholder="sx, ox, sy, oy"},
			{key="SizeScale",   label="Size Scale",  type="axis_graph_select", axes={"X","Y"}},
			{key="AnchorPoint", label="AnchorPoint", type="input", default="0.5, 0.5", placeholder="x, y"},
			{key="ZIndex",      label="ZIndex",      type="input", default="1"},
		}},
		{name = "Motion", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Speed",         label="Speed (px/s)",   type="graph"},
			{key="EmissionAngle", label="EmissionAngle",  type="input", default="90", placeholder="degrees"},
			{key="SpreadAngle",   label="SpreadAngle",    type="input", default="0",  placeholder="degrees"},
			{key="Acceleration",  label="Acceleration",   type="input", default="0, 0", placeholder="x, y"},
			{key="Drag",          label="Drag",           type="input", default="0"},
			{key="InvertMotion",  label="Reverse Motion", type="toggle"},
		}},
		{name = "Flipbook", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="FlipbookSource",      label="Source",     type="dropdown", options={"Decals","Spritesheet"}, default="Decals"},
			-- Canonical Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode option list  -  kept in sync with the native PE
			-- counterpart in BuildProperties.luau (both ship Loop/OneShot/PingPong/Random).
			{key="FlipbookMode",        label="Play Mode",  type="dropdown", options={"Loop","OneShot","PingPong","Random"}, default="Loop"},
			{key="Grid",                label="Grid",       type="input", default="8, 8",   placeholder="cols, rows"},
			{key="FlipbookFramerate",   label="Framerate",  type="input", default="10"},
			{key="FlipbookStartRandom", label="StartRandom",type="toggle"},
			{key="FlipbookReverse",     label="Reverse",    type="toggle"},
		}},
		imageLabelAdvanced(),
	}
	refs.ImageLabelSection, refs.ImageLabel = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "ImageLabels", imageLabelDefs, 11)
	refs.ImageLabelSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.ImageLabel, refs.ImageLabelSection, "ImageLabel")
	-- Spritesheet-only Grid row starts hidden. Populate flips it visible when FlipbookSource =
	-- Spritesheet on a selected ImageLabel. Without this, it'd show on initial section expand.
	if refs.ImageLabel.Grid and refs.ImageLabel.Grid.input then refs.ImageLabel.Grid.row.Visible = false end
end

return BuildPropertiesScreen

children.source:
--[[
	ConfigPanel  -  small modal popups for per-property advanced configuration. Currently exposes:

	  openInstancePicker(opts)  -  picks any Instance from Studio Selection.
	    opts.title    : panel title text
	    opts.label    : prompt label above the instance line ("Pick the target")
	    opts.onSet(inst): called when user clicks Set with the currently-selected Instance
	    opts.onCancel() : called when user dismisses

	Future: openAxisLink(opts) for linking SizeX↔SizeY↔SizeZ etc.
]]

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return function(deps)
	local W = deps.W
	local T = deps.T

	local _activePanel = nil

	local function closeActive()
		if _activePanel then
			pcall(function() _activePanel:close() end)
			_activePanel = nil
		end
	end

	local function openInstancePicker(opts)
		closeActive()

		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then
			warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui  -  cannot open picker")
			return
		end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_InstancePicker"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		-- Tall enough to fit title + context-line + prompt + instance line + buttons.
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 138)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)

		-- Title bar
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = opts.title or "Configure"
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		-- Context  -  which items this panel is editing. Stays visible even if user changes Studio
		-- Selection while the panel is open.
		if opts.context and opts.context ~= "" then
			local contextLine = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			contextLine.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			contextLine.Text = "for: " .. opts.context
			contextLine.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			contextLine.Font = T.Font
			contextLine.TextSize = 10
			contextLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			contextLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			contextLine.ZIndex = 201
			contextLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
			contextLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			contextLine.Parent = panel
		end

		local hasContext = opts.context and opts.context ~= ""
		local promptY = hasContext and 40 or 22
		local instanceY = hasContext and 58 or 40

		-- Prompt
		local prompt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		prompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		prompt.Text = opts.label or "Select an instance:"
		prompt.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		prompt.Font = T.Font
		prompt.TextSize = 10
		prompt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		prompt.ZIndex = 201
		prompt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
		prompt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, promptY)
		prompt.Parent = panel

		-- Selected-instance label
		local instanceLine = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		instanceLine.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		instanceLine.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		instanceLine.Text = "Instance: <nil>"
		instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		instanceLine.Font = T.Font
		instanceLine.TextSize = 11
		instanceLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		instanceLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		instanceLine.ZIndex = 201
		instanceLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
		instanceLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, instanceY)
		instanceLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
		instanceLine.Parent = panel
		W.addCorner(instanceLine, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(instanceLine, 6, 6, 0, 0)

		-- Buttons
		local function makeBtn(text, col, x)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
			b.BackgroundColor3 = col
			b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			b.Text = text
			b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			b.Font = T.Font
			b.TextSize = 11
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.ZIndex = 201
			b.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4))
			W.addStroke(b)
			return b
		end
		-- Three buttons when opts.allowClear is set, two otherwise. Clear writes
		-- nil through opts.onClear so picker-managed ObjectValue / direct properties
		-- can be unset without leaving the panel.
		local setBtn, clearBtn, cancelBtn
		if opts.allowClear then
			local function makeBtn3(text, col, x)
				local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
				b.BackgroundColor3 = col; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
				b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
				b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
				b.Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -3, 0, 22)
				b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
				b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201; b.Parent = panel
				W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b)
				return b
			end
			setBtn = makeBtn3("Set", T.BlobBg, 0)
			clearBtn = makeBtn3("Clear", T.BlobBg, 1/3)
			cancelBtn = makeBtn3("Cancel", T.BlobBg, 2/3)
		else
			setBtn = makeBtn("Set", T.BlobBg, 0)
			cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", T.BlobBg, 0.5)
		end

		local _selected = nil
		-- Recency cache: last non-empty Studio Selection observed during this picker's
		-- lifetime. Acts as fallback when Set is clicked and live Selection is empty  - 
		-- happens when clicking the Set button itself clears focus from Studio Explorer
		-- (Studio quirk: focus shifts to plugin GUI → Selection reported as empty mid-click).
		local _selectedCache = nil
		-- Exclude set built from opts.excludeItems (typically the source items the
		-- picker was opened for) so Set can't accidentally write self-as-target.
		local excludeSet = {}
		if opts.excludeItems then
			for _, ex in ipairs(opts.excludeItems) do excludeSet[ex] = true end
		end
		local function refreshFromSelection()
			local sel = Selection:Get()
			local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
			-- Skip self-as-target: clear the line so the user has to consciously pick a
			-- different instance instead of accidentally committing self.
			if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
			_selected = picked
			if picked then _selectedCache = picked end
			instanceLine.Text = _selected and ("Instance: " .. _selected:GetFullName())
				or (_selectedCache and ("Instance: " .. _selectedCache:GetFullName() .. " (cached)"))
				or "Instance: <nil>"
		end
		refreshFromSelection()
		-- Register through ConnectionManager so plugin teardown disconnects this
		-- listener even if the picker close path never fires (e.g. plugin disabled
		-- mid-pick). The local `conn` still handles the normal Set/Cancel close.
		local conn = Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(refreshFromSelection)
		if deps.Connections then deps.Connections["ConfigPanelInstancePicker"] = conn end

		-- 200ms poll: catches Selection states that never fire SelectionChanged during
		-- this picker's lifetime (e.g. Roblox Deferred signal dropping events under load).
		-- Loop exits when panel is destroyed (panel.Parent == nil).
		local _alive = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while _alive do
				task.wait(0.2)
				if not _alive then return end
				local sel = Selection:Get()
				local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
				if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
				if picked then _selectedCache = picked end
			end
		end)

		local function close(commit)
			_alive = false
			if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			-- Commit prefers live Selection; falls back to cache so a Set click that races
			-- with Studio clearing Selection still writes the user's most-recent pick.
			local commitTarget = _selected or _selectedCache
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(commitTarget) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end

		-- Snapshot Selection on MouseDown  -  fires BEFORE Studio's focus-shift cascade
		-- clears Selection on plugin-GUI click. By the time Activated (MouseUp) fires,
		-- Selection is reported empty. MouseDown runs while Studio Selection still
		-- holds the pick. Mirrored on the panel background so a mouse-down anywhere
		-- in the picker captures the live pick, not just the Set button.
		local function snapshotSelectionNow()
			local sel = Selection:Get()
			local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
			if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
			if picked then
				_selectedCache = picked
				_selected = picked
				instanceLine.Text = "Instance: " .. picked:GetFullName()
			end
		end
		setBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(snapshotSelectionNow)
		panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then snapshotSelectionNow() end
		end)

		-- Run opts.validate(picked) BEFORE closing. When validation rejects, the
		-- panel stays open + the prompt label flashes a hint so the user knows
		-- their pick was wrong instead of seeing the panel vanish silently.
		setBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- Force a Selection re-read at click time. Deferred SignalBehavior can let the
			-- Set button fire before our SelectionChanged listener runs, leaving _selected
			-- stale (or pinned to a previous pick like the parent Frame of a CanvasGroup).
			refreshFromSelection()
			-- Live Selection beats cache; cache covers the case where clicking Set itself
			-- caused Studio to report empty Selection (the 0.2s poll captured the last
			-- valid pick before that).
			local target = _selected or _selectedCache
			if not target then
				instanceLine.Text = "No instance selected  -  click one in Studio first"
				instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.Red or Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
				return
			end
			if opts.validate then
				local okValid, msg = opts.validate(target)
				if not okValid then
					instanceLine.Text = msg or "Invalid selection  -  pick a different instance"
					instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.Red or Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
					return
				end
			end
			_selected = target
			close(true)
		end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		if clearBtn then
			clearBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
				panel:Destroy()
				if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
				if opts.onClear then opts.onClear() end
			end)
		end

		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- Axis-link picker. opts.axes is a list of full property keys (e.g. {"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"}).
	-- opts.current is a table { [axisKey] = primaryKey or nil } reflecting current LinkedTo state.
	-- Set callback receives a linkMap of the same shape (primary axis maps to nil).
	local function openAxisLinkPanel(opts)
		closeActive()
		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui"); return end
		local axes = opts.axes or {}
		if #axes == 0 then return end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_AxisLink"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 158)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0; panel.ZIndex = 200; panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true); panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = opts.title or "Link axes"; title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 12; title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201; title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		if opts.context and opts.context ~= "" then
			local ctxLine = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ctxLine.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			ctxLine.Text = "for: " .. opts.context; ctxLine.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			ctxLine.Font = T.Font; ctxLine.TextSize = 10; ctxLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			ctxLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd; ctxLine.ZIndex = 201
			ctxLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); ctxLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			ctxLine.Parent = panel
		end

		-- Build axis-set for sanitizing incoming current state.
		local axisSet = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do axisSet[a] = true end
		-- Sanitize: drop self-links and any LinkedTo value not in this row's axes list.
		-- Stale or hand-edited bad attrs can otherwise round-trip forever.
		local linkMap = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
			local v = opts.current and opts.current[a] or nil
			if v == a or (v ~= nil and not axisSet[v]) then v = nil end
			linkMap[a] = v
		end
		local primary
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
			if linkMap[a] == nil then
				local hasFollower = false
				for _, b in ipairs(axes) do if b ~= a and linkMap[b] == a then hasFollower = true; break end end
				if hasFollower then primary = a; break end
			end
		end
		if not primary then primary = axes[1] end
		-- Strip self-links from initial state.
		if linkMap[primary] then linkMap[primary] = nil end

		local prompt = Instance.new("TextLabel"); prompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		prompt.Text = "Primary axis (others can link to it):"; prompt.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		prompt.Font = T.Font; prompt.TextSize = 10; prompt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		prompt.ZIndex = 201; prompt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); prompt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 38)
		prompt.Parent = panel

		local pillW = math.floor((280 - 16 - (#axes - 1) * 4) / #axes)
		local pills = {}
		-- Side table: TextButton Instance -> axisKey. Roblox Instances don't accept arbitrary
		-- custom fields so attaching `b.AxisKey = ...` would silently fail and downstream reads
		-- would index nil.
		local pillAxes = {}
		-- Axes the user actually touched. onSet writes only these so a Set on a
		-- mixed multi-selection doesn't overwrite untouched per-item state.
		local dirtyAxes = {}
		local function refreshPills()
			for _, p in ipairs(pills) do
				local axisKey = pillAxes[p]
				if axisKey == primary then
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BrightGold; p.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					p.TextColor3 = T.PanelBg; p.Text = axisKey .. " *"
				elseif linkMap[axisKey] == primary then
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					p.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; p.Text = axisKey .. " ->"
				else
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					p.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; p.Text = axisKey
				end
			end
		end
		for i, axisKey in ipairs(axes) do
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = axisKey .. "Pill"
			b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11; b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, pillW, 0, 22)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * (pillW + 4), 0, 56)
			b.Parent = panel; W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b)
			pillAxes[b] = axisKey
			pills[#pills + 1] = b
			-- Single InputBegan handler for MouseButton1: shift-held promotes axis to primary
			-- (followers re-anchor to the new primary). Plain click toggles linked-to-primary.
			b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
				local shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
				if shift then
					primary = axisKey; linkMap[axisKey] = nil
					for _, other in ipairs(axes) do
						if other ~= primary and linkMap[other] ~= nil then linkMap[other] = primary end
						dirtyAxes[other] = true
					end
				elseif axisKey ~= primary then
					if linkMap[axisKey] == primary then linkMap[axisKey] = nil
					else linkMap[axisKey] = primary end
					dirtyAxes[axisKey] = true
				end
				refreshPills()
			end)
		end
		refreshPills()

		local primaryHint = Instance.new("TextLabel"); primaryHint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		primaryHint.Text = "(shift-click an axis to make it primary)"; primaryHint.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		primaryHint.Font = T.Font; primaryHint.TextSize = 9; primaryHint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		primaryHint.ZIndex = 201; primaryHint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12); primaryHint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 84)
		primaryHint.Parent = panel

		local function makeBtn(text, x)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22); b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201; b.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b); return b
		end
		local setBtn = makeBtn("Set", 0); local cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", 0.5)

		local function close(commit)
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(linkMap, dirtyAxes) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end
		setBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(true) end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- True while either the instance picker OR the axis-link panel is open.
	-- Callers (init.server.lua's SelectionChanged hook) gate handleSelection on
	-- this so a Studio Selection change made WHILE the picker is open doesn't
	-- repopulate the Properties panel out from under the user  -  the picker uses
	-- Selection to read the user's chosen target, but the rest of the plugin
	-- should stay frozen on the source items being configured.
	local function isOpen() return _activePanel ~= nil end

	return {
		openInstancePicker = openInstancePicker,
		openAxisLinkPanel = openAxisLinkPanel,
		closeActive = closeActive,
		isOpen = isOpen,
	}
end

	-- the `_noFontOverride` attribute. Set by: Modules/UIBuilder/init.luau,
	-- Modules/UIBuilder/InventoryPanel.luau, Modules/UIBuilder/InventoryDissectDialog.

}

-- Exact default shades (never derived, always these on reset)
Constants.DEFAULT_TEXT_SHADES = {
	BrightGold = Color3.fromRGB(232, 213, 168),
	Gold = Color3.fromRGB(196, 162, 101),
	MutedGold = Color3.fromRGB(154, 122, 72),
	DarkGold = Color3.fromRGB(122, 90, 48),
}

-- Derive 4 text shades from a custom accent color (used only for non-default colors)
function Constants.deriveTextShades(base)
	local h, s, v = base:ToHSV()
	local bright = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(0, s * 0.55), math.min(1, v * 1.2))
	local muted = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(1, s * 1.15), v * 0.78)
	local dark = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(1, s * 1.25), v * 0.62)
	return bright, base, muted, dark
end

-- Check if a color matches the default text accent
local DEFAULT_TEXT_ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(196, 162, 101)
function Constants.isDefaultTextAccent(c)
	return math.abs(c.R - DEFAULT_TEXT_ACCENT.R) < 0.02
		and math.abs(c.G - DEFAULT_TEXT_ACCENT.G) < 0.02
		and math.abs(c.B - DEFAULT_TEXT_ACCENT.B) < 0.02
end

-- Hex conversion utilities
function Constants.color3ToHex(c)
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R*255+0.5), math.floor(c.G*255+0.5), math.floor(c.B*255+0.5))
end

function Constants.hexToColor3(hex)
	hex = hex:gsub("#","")
	if #hex == 3 then hex = hex:sub(1,1):rep(2)..hex:sub(2,2):rep(2)..hex:sub(3,3):rep(2) end
	if #hex ~= 6 then return nil end
	local r, g, b = tonumber(hex:sub(1,2),16), tonumber(hex:sub(3,4),16), tonumber(hex:sub(5,6),16)
	if not r or not g or not b then return nil end
	return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
end
